title: YourMondayMotivator: What's in your toolbox?
html:
Everyone has a different bunch of tools available to them. Different methods of doing things built from experiences over their lifetime.

If you think about your experiences emotionally, mentally and physically adding to a toolbox - wouldn't you want to have the best? Personally I like Snap-on tools. Lifetime guarantee, beautiful actions (movement) and you know they will do what you expect them to do. You can work on a project knowing you have the best tools for the job. So, are the tools you are putting in your toolbox that good? Will they do what you expect them to do when you need them? By tools I mean the experiences, education and fitness etc you are doing every day that make you who you are today. You can change the tools you want to use at any time. Seriously, if you think about yourself as a toolbox you will be more mindful about pulling out the correct tool for the job at the correct time. This week have a think about the tools you are buying / collecting and go for the best. They will last you a lifetime. Have a great week.
